_comment: Creative-engine enforcement rules for Ideal Sports Performance (ISP), Fort Worth TX. Consumed by scripts/validate-plan.mjs via loadRules(). Mirrors the brand-agnostic AA structure; brand-specific differences from AA: (1) eyebrowPattern anchors Fort Worth baseball parents; (2) noExclamation is FALSE — ISP's documented brand voice uses exclamation on CTAs ('Try ISP Free!'), so it is permitted here (emoji still banned); (3) ISP publishes NO guarantee, so the guarantee role renders empty and is not required.
_beatRolesNote: anyOf = the beat's VALID role set; an asset must carry >=1 (playbook: 1 dominant + ~2 supporting, ONE dominant beat per static). ISP has no guarantee, so guaranteeDrift is a no-op.
